facts.fact: 舞会是为 Haven 与 New Columbia 办的，说白了就是「盛装对着那些更想捅死的人微笑」。
facts.anchor: A ball had been arranged in honor of the Haven and New Columbia, a courteous way of saying we’d all dressed up to smile at people we’d sooner gut.

facts.fact: 情报：Xander 是长生 warlock——旧说 warlock 是恶魔与女巫所生；外貌年轻、英俊、琥珀色眼睛，看人像在清点。
facts.anchor: he was an immortal warlock, and the old stories said a warlock was what you got when a demon bred with a witch.

facts.fact: 三方各有算盘：Xander 要土地与收藏，New Columbia 要人类统治，Covenant 要白女巫死——一张桌下三把刀。
facts.anchor: Three sets of knives under one table.

facts.fact: 谈判只要拖三天就够夜莺行动潜入再撤出。
facts.anchor: Three days was what Operation Nightingale needed—long enough to slip in and slip out.

facts.fact: 今晚 Max 就走——不带他；他认为她把他踢出队伍是「拿旧怨扭曲判断」的孩子气错误。
facts.anchor: Max Morning would leave tonight. Without me.

facts.fact: 龙讽他：哪个心智正常的男人会对着一个蜷着看言情小说的女人拔剑？你该亲她。
facts.anchor: What sane man draws a blade on a woman curled up with a romance novel?

facts.fact: 龙正式宣布与他切割，并说：她分得清我们俩——她双手捧过我的脸、摸过我的鼻梁，她永远不会对你这样做。
facts.anchor: I am formally distancing myself from you, you crazy son of a bitch

facts.fact: 全场同时回头：Max Morning，穿着礼服。
facts.anchor: There she was. Max Fucking Morning, in a gown.

facts.fact: Aelindor 的礼服暗织五色：四大家族之色，第五色不属于任何家族——午夜蓝，缀一道白。她的颜色。
facts.anchor: a fifth that belonged to no house at all. Midnight blue, shot through with a single streak of white. Her color.

facts.fact: 她也选了 Aelindor 那件；而他自己那件蓝如龙火的礼服早已做好，一直没送出去。
facts.anchor: And here she stood. I wasn’t remotely surprised she’d chosen Aelindor’s

facts.fact: Xander 看她的眼神是占有性的——像看一件还没收齐的稀有藏品。
facts.anchor: He looked at her possessively, as if she were simply a rare thing he hadn’t finished acquiring yet.

facts.fact: 恐惧压上来：她若回不来呢？若 Haven 把她吞掉，若这是个陷阱……他无法呼吸。
facts.anchor: What if she didn’t come back?
